name: Hawthorn Andrena
desc: Hawthorn Andrena (Andrena crataegi): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Andrena crataegi, the hawthorn miner bee, is a species of miner bee in the family Andrenidae which is in the order Hymenoptera ("ants, bees, wasps and sawflies").
